messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — I noticed a spike in duplicate accounts after last night's CRM import. Our health scoring is double-counting engagement for some customers. Suggest we add a temporary "dedupe_flag" to keep potential dups out of the health calculation and run a merge/label playbook. Thoughts?

Oliver Chen: Ugh, saw that too. Do we have a quick query to identify likely duplicates? Maybe email + company fuzzy match.

Raj Singh: We can run a deterministic pass first (exact email + company) then a fuzzy pass. For fuzzy: levenshtein on name + domain and last_active within 90d. Keeps false positives low.

Tia Alvarez: Can the playbook be automated so CS owners are prompted to confirm merges? We shouldn't auto-merge without human review for enterprise accounts.

Maya Patel: Agreed — automated suggestions + owner confirmation for accounts with ARR > $10k. Auto-merge safe for accounts flagged as bots/internal/test.

Samir Brooks: From a scoring POV we should exclude dedupe_flagged records from the rolling 30/90d metrics until resolved. That way renewal risk calc isn't skewed.

Oliver Chen: SQL prototype I used tonight:```sql
-- candidate duplicates: exact email OR same domain + similar name
SELECT a.id AS acct_a, b.id AS acct_b, a.email, a.name, a.company
FROM accounts a
JOIN accounts b ON a.id < b.id
WHERE (a.email = b.email)
   OR (split_part(a.email,'@',2) = split_part(b.email,'@',2) AND levenshtein(lower(a.name), lower(b.name)) < 3)
LIMIT 100;
```

Raj Singh: Nice. We should tag results with reason codes (email_match, domain_name_fuzzy) so playbook UI shows why it's suggested.

Tia Alvarez: How do we wire this into existing playbook automation? Can we post suggestions as tasks in the CS queue and include one-click actions (Confirm Merge / Mark False Positive / Escalate)?

Maya Patel: Plan: 1) Run nightly dedupe pass, write candidates to "crm_dedupe_suggestions" 2) Add dedupe_flag boolean on accounts 3) Playbook reads suggestions and surfaces to CS queue with reason and preview 4) Owner confirms -> call merge API 5) If ignored for 14 days, send a weekly digest to AM.

Samir Brooks: Can we add a quick metric to console for "dedupe_adjusted_active_accounts" so we can compare before/after? Also we should snapshot health_score distribution pre-change for rollout checks.

Oliver Chen: I can push a lightweight lambda to run the nightly pass and emit to topic "cs.dedupe.suggestions". Need schema: acct_a, acct_b, reason, confidence_score, suggested_owner.

Maya Patel: Perfect. @cs-bot can we schedule a one-off run today at 11:30 and dump the top 500 candidates to #incidents for review? :eyes:

cs-bot: Scheduled: nightly_dedupe_run triggered by Maya Patel. One-off run queued for 2024-06-02 11:30 UTC. Will post results to #incidents when done.

Raj Singh: Quick note on rollback: keep a merge audit log and reversible operation for 30 days (soft-merge). If the customer notices data loss, we can revert.

Tia Alvarez: Also add a short help copy in the playbook modal explaining why a suggestion was generated + quick links to the account timeline. Reduces clicks for owners.

Maya Patel: Awesome. Next steps: Oliver to prototype lambda + topic, Raj to produce merge-safe flow + audit schema, Tia to mock playbook UI and action verbs, Samir to add metrics. I'll follow up with a short RFC after first run. Thanks! :thumbsup:
